body: @vvo I made a [repo](https://github.com/yonidej/Meteor-Instantsearch.js) for Meteor + Instantsearch.js compatibility. In addition to using the DOMContentLoaded event, I had to remove the getTemplate function and use a Mustache String template instead of wrapping it in a script like the [tutorial](https://www.algolia.com/doc/search/instant-search#templates). It probably has something to do with Blaze templating...Anyways, hope this helps!
